name: Similar historical disruption exists

input_disruption.description: Critical port congestion at European hub delaying micro-controller delivery from key supplier.

expected_behavior: Retrieve similar past port congestion records in Europe/Electronics; recommend vetted historical response strategy with confidence supported by case count.

name: No highly similar disruption exists

input_disruption.description: Unprecedented geothermal event halts specialized titanium refinery in remote sub-Antarctic zone.

expected_behavior: Acknowledge sparse historical precedent, flag human review required, and avoid fabricating statistics or hallucinated cases.

name: High-severity disruption triage

input_disruption.description: Ransomware encryption across regional semiconductor packaging facility halts 100% of shipments.

expected_behavior: Classify as Critical severity, compute priority score >= 75 (High/Critical), and recommend urgent alternative supplier activation.

name: Low-severity minor disruption

input_disruption.description: Minor customs inspection delay at land border crossing for non-critical packaging components.

expected_behavior: Classify as Low severity, compute priority score <= 45 (Low/Guarded), and suggest mild expediting or safety stock buffer without costly supplier overhaul.

name: High financial loss scenario

input_disruption.description: Major tier-1 power plant transformer failure halting automotive assembly line with projected multimillion-dollar losses.

expected_behavior: Predict high financial loss in USD, reflect loss component in priority score, and identify key drivers in feature importance explanation.

name: High production impact scenario

input_disruption.description: Chemical feedstock supplier explosion eliminates 80% of active solvent supply for medical diagnostic devices.

expected_behavior: Predict substantial production impact %, evaluate operational recovery days, and highlight alternate formulation or supplier switch.

name: Regional supplier differentiation (Asia-Pacific)

input_disruption.description: Typhoon damages port infrastructure and logistics terminals in coastal manufacturing hub.

expected_behavior: Filter historical cases specifically to Asia-Pacific and natural disaster events; verify regional metadata filter adherence.

name: Labor disruption strategy formulation

input_disruption.description: Dockworkers strike across multiple marine terminals stalling inbound automotive sub-assemblies.

expected_behavior: Retrieve labor strike precedents and formulate rerouting or expedited air cargo mitigation with historical recovery baselines.

name: Supplier Tier 3 metadata constraint

input_disruption.description: Raw silicon wafer sub-supplier insolvency halts raw material pipeline for tier 2 component assemblers.

expected_behavior: Strictly filter retrieval candidates by supplier_tier == '3' and verify 100% precision of retrieved tiers.

name: Recommendation quality and strategy validity

input_disruption.description: Prolonged customs audit on critical pharmaceutical active ingredients in European distribution lane.

expected_behavior: Generate strategy supported verbatim by historical effectiveness groups; verify confidence capping and explainable reasoning points.
